column1: # Grammatical category labels (gloss abbreviations), after Christian Lehmann,
# label<TAB>meaning<TAB>kind: 'label' = recommended label; 'alias' = the meaning is written with this label
# (the source gives it in parentheses: 'see this label'). Optional letters of the source, e.g. app(r)h,
# are expanded to both forms; 'cl#' stands for CL followed by a number. Labels are upper case (Leipzig rules).
